messages:
support_jess: AcmeCorp onboarding hit 422 on POST /v1/tools/payments.create. Customer payload missing billing_profile.id and is sending amount as a string ("100.00"). Also validator flagged additionalProperties 'billing'. Request_id req_0a1b2c3d, trace_id trace-20260315-77. Repro steps + logs below.

tyler_eng: can you paste the exact request body, headers, and the API response body? need request_id/trace to correlate.

support_jess: curl (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/payments.create" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount": "100.00",
    "currency": "USD",
    "description": "Q1 invoice",
    "billing_profile": { "name": "Acme Corp" },
    "metadata": { "order_id": "ORD-9823" }
  }'
```

API response (422):

```
{
  "error": "schema_validation_failed",
  "details": [
    { "path": "/billing_profile", "message": "missing required property 'id'" },
    { "path": "/amount", "message": "expected number, got string" },
    { "path": "", "message": "additionalProperties not allowed: 'billing'" }
  ],
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d",
  "trace_id": "trace-20260315-77"
}
```

maria_cs: customer SDK (internal JS lib) formats money as strings by default. They assumed server would upsert a billing_profile when name provided. They also say this only fails on their Private deployment (us-west-2); same payload against Hosted returns 200.

timezone_runtime: i checked the private stack config — we enabled "strict_json_schema": true for private clusters (change applied 2026-02-28). That explains required/additionalProperties failures. No coercion layer exists for money fields; we intentionally disabled coercion to avoid silent unit mismatches for billing.

tyler_eng: action items: (1) tell customer to include billing_profile.id or create profile via billing.profiles.create; and coerce amount to numeric on their SDK as immediate workaround. (2) ENG-RUNTIME ticket to evaluate an opt-in compatibility mode for private deploys to accept numeric strings for money fields and controlled additionalProperties relaxation.

support_jess: shared the workaround with AcmeCorp; they're able to proceed for now. Marking this escalated; opening ticket ENG-RUNTIME-4583 with request_id req_0a1b2c3d + trace-20260315-77 and attaching logs.

engbot: deploy-notice: config change "strict_json_schema=true" applied to private/us-west-2 on 2026-02-28 by infra_ops. Change doc: https://deployments.redwood/internal/changes/strict-json-schema-20260228

runtime_oncall: will triage ENG-RUNTIME-4583. Need to coordinate with infra and security before any relax/coercion. Risk assessment required :eyes:

maria_cs: updated customer success ticket; tracking until eng has plan. If they hit further errors after adding id and numeric amount we'll reopen.

support_jess: closing loop in thread — customer ok with workaround for now. Reopen if anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
